facts.fact: Decreto Presidencial n.º 60/21 of 10 March 2021 approves the Regulamento das Taxas a Cobrar pela APD, made under the legislation on personal data protection, setting fees for registering files and authorising personal data processing, with 60% of receipts to the APD and 40% to the Treasury single account.
